meta.title: The bidding-summary rank filter only offers sensible limits
gaps: Assert that the menu contains only the three expected options: the catalog cannot enumerate menu contents, and the required named-element selectors cannot count all unspecified options.
Assert that the All Vendors request URL omits rank_limit: expect_request supports matching a query fragment but not asserting a query parameter is absent.
Measure and assert that the bidding-summary panel refreshes every 30 seconds.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that the menu contains only the three expected options: the catalog cannot enumerate menu contents, and the required named-element selectors cannot count all unspecified options.; Assert that the All Vendors request URL omits rank_limit: expect_request supports matching a query fragment but not asserting a query parameter is absent.; Measure and assert that the bidding-summary panel refreshes every 30 seconds.

steps.note: Open the setup auction with three active participants rather than creating another event.
Reach Event Details and its Bidding Summary section.
Assert the top-one rank limit is offered.
Assert the top-two rank limit is offered.
Assert the unrestricted option is offered.
Check that a successful summary read occurred during the run; this does not establish parameter omission, click causality, or the refresh interval.
